name: Bright Star Acres
description: Bright Star Acres grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 3852 Alexander Road, KY. The farm is small, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
